items.title: Nucor (NUE) Stock Fair Value Edges Higher As Analysts Weigh Growth Against Cost Pressures
items.summary: Price targets on Nucor have shifted, with bullish analysts now pointing to a US$300 to US$345 range, while more cautious views cluster around US$280 to US$296. This split reflects differing emphasis on longer term earnings power and cash generation versus nearer term guidance, cost pressures and policy risk, which feeds directly into how much analysts are prepared to pay for the stock. items.title: Does Earnings And Capacity Expansion Change The Bull Case For Nucor (NUE)?
items.summary: Nucor has seen its shares rise 82% over the past year, supported by strong recent earnings, higher realized steel prices and expansion projects such as the West Virginia sheet mill and the Berkeley galvanizing line. The combination of higher shipment volumes and new capacity coming online indicates that Nucor is increasingly tying its earnings profile to large scale, multi year capital projects that need to ramp efficiently to justify prior spending.
